summary: The previous PR-18-3-01 sequencing finding remains resolved. The newer index-placement assumption underlying plan-review-03 and definition-review-01 has been invalidated and corrected at spec and plan: installed CodeGraph 1.5.0 directory.js confines CODEGRAPH_DIR to one in-project segment, with matching pinned file hashes, and [upstream issue #986](https://github.com/colbymchenry/codegraph/issues/986) requests external storage rather than establishing it. The plan gives a concrete conditional regular-file staging option with source scope, proposed file/byte/time ceilings, no symlink traversal, change detection, relative provenance, fail-closed cap behavior and cleanup. It preserves 18.1 source authority and assigns the shared root/lease to 18.2 while 18.3 owns CodeGraph placement. Explicit human copy authority and an identifiable verified 18.2 lease checkpoint remain absent; the plan correctly blocks physical preparation, application-bound native invocation and Vulgata qualification until both are resolved and affected tasks/reviews rerun. Declining copy leaves required O-FR05 unmet, which the plan reports rather than treating file tools or the standalone probe as completion. Architecture classification and the Worker-tool/Scan planned-change trigger remain explicit. The seven-file canonical digest and mapped spec/plan hashes match current files; read-only deterministic plan validation returned no errors. SpecKit task analysis was not applied because the existing tasks are invalidated and unmapped for this plan-only review. ACCEPT makes this conditional plan reviewable for the separate human architecture decision; it supplies no copy, implementation or completion authority.
